title: RentGuard Reinstatement Cure Payment by Card
content:
The cure amount on a RentGuard Renters Policy cancelled for nonpayment is paid by the named insured with a payment card.

## Rule

> A named insured asking to reinstate a policy cancelled for nonpayment pays the cure amount by card in one payment; the cancellation credit is left out of it because reinstatement reverses that credit, and the reinstatement fee is not part of it because it is charged at reinstatement.

| Point | What the rule provides |
|---|---|
| Who pays | the named insured of the RentGuard policy |
| Which policy | a policy cancelled for nonpayment, on the named insured's request to reinstate it |
| What is paid | the cure amount |
| How it is paid | by card, in one payment |
| Cancellation credit | left out of the cure amount, because reinstatement reverses that credit |
| Reinstatement fee | not part of the cure amount, because it is charged at reinstatement |

## Paying the cure with `pay_reinstatement_cure_5468a22a`

**Situation of use and capability.** The tool charges the customer's payment card once for the amount given and records it as a single card payment received on the premium account of the customer's own cancelled RentGuard renters policy, dated today, lowering the premium balance by that amount. Nothing else on the policy changes. The customer receives a payment confirmation number and can see the payment on the premium account.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, naming `pay_reinstatement_cure_5468a22a`, which hands it over to the customer; the customer themselves then runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`. The agent does not run the payment on the customer's behalf.

**Parameters.**

- `renters_policy_id` — the reference number of the customer's cancelled RentGuard renters policy record, as read out to the customer by the representative from the renters policy lookup (text id).
- `amount` — the amount to pay, in USD with 2 decimal places, a positive figure exactly as the representative tells the customer.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `renters_policy_id` | the cancelled RentGuard renters policy record | text id from the renters policy lookup |
| `amount` | the amount the card is charged | USD, 2 decimal places, positive |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence giving the payment confirmation number (text starting with 2), the amount paid in USD with 2 decimal places, the payment date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the premium balance now standing (USD, 2 decimal places, negative when it is a credit). Receiving it means the payment is recorded.

## Basis questions

**Is the cancellation credit counted in the cure amount?** No. The cancellation credit is left out of the cure amount, because reinstatement reverses that credit.

**Is the reinstatement fee paid as part of the cure?** No. The reinstatement fee is not part of the cure amount; it is charged at reinstatement.

**May the cure be paid in instalments or by another method?** The rule provides for the cure amount to be paid by card in one payment.
